topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Hey, I just heard what's been going on with you and your partner. I can’t even imagine what you must be thinking right now. Discovering something like that, a whole novel about you? It’s just... it’s a lot, you know? Maybe you’re feeling like everything you thought you knew is just different now, or maybe it’s just a surprise, I guess. But I just want you to know, whatever it is, I’m here. You don’t have to figure this out alone. We can talk about it, or not talk about it, whatever you need. Just please, take care of yourself, okay?
